categories.main_business_segments: China Water Affairs Group Limited operates primarily in five segments: city water supply, pipeline direct drinking water supply, environmental protection (including sewage treatment and drainage), main contractor construction, and property development and investment. The company focuses on integrated water services including raw water, tap water, direct drinking water, sewage treatment, drainage, and water environmental renovation across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs urban-rural water supply integration and supply-drainage integration technologies, with emphasis on smart water management systems and differentiated water supply technology. It also engages in construction and operation of water infrastructure, sewage treatment plants, and pipeline direct drinking water systems, leveraging technological upgrades to enhance water quality and service efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves municipal and provincial governments, urban populations, and industrial customers across China. Its services cover water supply, direct drinking water, sewage treatment, and environmental protection, targeting over 30 million people in 25 provinces. The property segment serves commercial and residential markets through development and investment projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: China Water Affairs Group operates extensively across mainland China, covering provinces including Hunan, Hubei, Henan, Hebei, Guizhou, Hainan, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Guangdong (including Shenzhen), Chongqing, Shandong, Shanxi, Heilongjiang, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangxi, Tianjin, Anhui, Zhejiang, Yunnan, Sichuan, Ningxia, Fujian, Liaoning, Shaanxi, and others. Its registered and principal offices are in Hong Kong and Bermuda.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water supply chain, including water sourcing, treatment, distribution, and sewage treatment. It also undertakes construction as a main contractor for municipal water infrastructure projects, positioning itself as an integrated operator in water and environmental services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the Group focuses on urban-rural water supply integration, supply-drainage integration, and expanding pipeline direct drinking water business to create a twin-driver portfolio. It prioritizes projects with the best returns, emphasizes green and low-carbon development, and invests in smart water management and differentiated water supply technologies to enhance service quality and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through water supply operations, installation and maintenance services, construction services, sewage treatment and drainage operations, and property sales and rentals. The company also earns finance income, government subsidies, and dividends from associates. Revenue streams include point-in-time sales and overtime service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, China Water Affairs Group is positioned as a leading integrated water operator in China with extensive geographic coverage and diversified services. It holds significant market share in city water supply and environmental protection sectors, leveraging its scale and technological capabilities to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended March 2025, the Group reported revenue of HK$11.66 billion, a 9.4% decrease from the previous year, and a profit attributable to owners of HK$1.07 billion, down 29.9%. Total assets were HK$65.89 billion with a gearing ratio of 66.8%. The Group employs approximately 11,000 staff and maintains stable liquidity with ongoing refinancing to optimize debt structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes integrated, high-quality water services with a focus on safe and healthier water consumption through technological innovation and smart water management. Its value proposition includes comprehensive water supply solutions, environmental protection services, and sustainable development aligned with national low-carbon policies, aiming to deliver long-term shareholder value and societal benefits.
